connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.Endpoint URL*The base URL of your Grafana Cloud stack, e.g. https://mystack.grafana.net/Service Account Token*A Grafana Cloud service account token with access to the IRM app.ProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access Grafana IRM directly.Custom Rate LimitBy default, DevLake uses 3,600 requests/hour for data collection for Grafana IRM. But you can adjust the collection speed by setting up your desirable rate limit.
